stories.title: White rips critics, backed by Fever after fans boo
stories.summary: Fever coach Stephanie White spoke out against her critics and received vocal support from Caitlin Clark and Sophie Cunningham after she was booed in Indiana before Tuesday's win over the Liberty.

stories.title: Trimble leaves UNC 'home,' commits to Louisville
stories.summary: Seth Trimble has committed to play for Louisville next season following the court ruling that gave Class of 2022 high schoolers a fifth season of college eligibility.

stories.title: Tulsa kept from chance at LLBWS bid, judge rules
stories.summary: A Texas judge backed a decision to remove a Tulsa, Oklahoma, team from the Southwest Region and keep it from playing in Tuesday's title game for a spot in the Little League Baseball World Series, according to a statement from a Little League spokesperson.

stories.title: A's Wilson sees errorless run live on after overturn
stories.summary: After his surprising error was overturned to a Tampa Bay hit on Tuesday night in his club's 12-4 loss to the Rays at Sutter Health Park, Athletics shortstop Jacob Wilson's major-league-record errorless streak at the position was extended to 113 games.

stories.title: 'Awful' Raleigh takes blame as M's lose 5th in row
stories.summary: Cal Raleigh, saddled with a .159 average a year after finishing second in the AL MVP race, acknowledged his struggles after the Seattle Mariners' 4-1 loss to the New York Yankees on Tuesday night, telling reporters "I've got to find a way to be better."
